clips.title: The story
paras: Seeking Refuge is a Tirisfal Glades quest involving the rescue of Bareth Dawnstone, an emissary from Bandarion Keep held captive at Crusader's Outpost. His struggle highlights the emergence of an unconventional order devoted to the Holy Light despite severe prejudice from local zealots. Safely returning news of his escape to Brill secures vital ties for this fledgling sanctuary.

Seeking Refuge recounts the perilous journey of Bareth Dawnstone, a messenger dispatched from the secluded monastery of Bandarion Keep. While en route to confer with Shari Stilwell in Brill, Bareth was intercepted and captured by zealous warriors at Crusader's Outpost. Despite the hatred directed at his undead state, Bareth remains steadfast in his devotion to the Light, yearning only to escape his tormentors and ensure his message reaches its destination.

Bareth's captivity highlights the bitter ideological divide haunting Tirisfal Glades. The zealots at Crusader's Outpost channel the Holy Light through vengeful fury and dogmatic righteousness, viewing Bareth's existence as an affront. In stark contrast, Dawnstone meditates on the Light as a source of protection and inner purity, lamenting how his captors' cruelty distorts the sacred teachings he cherishes.

Following his escape, Bareth's safety is confirmed with Shari Stilwell in Brill. Stilwell reveals that their monastic order is still establishing its roots in the bluffs northwest of Solliden Farmstead. Losing a practitioner as promising as Dawnstone would have dealt a tragic blow to their young fellowship, which opens its doors to any traveler seeking authentic spiritual guidance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... All I strive to protect!
I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.

Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.
